glossary.definition: (A) "Firm" means any person or limited liability company that is legally engaged in rendering professional services.
glossary.source_title: Section 5526.01 - Contracts for professional services definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Federal Water Pollution Control Act" has the same meaning as in section 6111.01 of the Revised Code.
